title: Will Trump’s Endorsement of Netanyahu Fire Up His Campaign or Fizzle?
summary: President Trump said Benjamin Netanyahu was a “Great Warrior,” as he faces a tough re-election bid for prime minister. But the Trump brand is not what it once was in Israel, analysts say.
